traits.note: Drilled, physical, direct - the Crazy Gang punched far above the squad
The most drilled side in the league: rehearsed to the point that set pieces became a defining weapon. Slight right tilt through Saka.
The clearest example in the league of talent not turning into results — disjointed, poor in possession, better on the break than building.
Enormous individual talent and enormous squad turnover; a young side still learning each other. Palmer central-right is the outlet.
Guardiola sides are coached to the last detail; marked down slightly from their peak for a squad mid-rebuild. Everything funnels centrally to Haaland.
Aggressive, structured pressing with a heavy right side — Salah ahead of Alexander-Arnold is where the play goes.
A committed, high-risk system that produced wildly inconsistent weeks. Left-sided through Son.
A settled core under a long-serving manager; aggressive rather than intricate, and threat spread evenly.
Emery is among the best coaches in Europe at organising a mid-block and attacking the space behind it.
Iraola coached one of the most distinctive and demanding pressing systems in the division. Attacks come from wide.
The clearest case of organisation beating talent: direct, relentless on set pieces, and drilled far beyond what the squad list suggests.
A club with a coherent playing identity that survives manager changes, though less settled than at its peak. Heavily left-sided through Mitoma.
Glasner drilled the wing-back system hard. Width on both flanks is the whole plan.
Hard to play through, limited going forward, and genuinely dangerous from dead balls. Central and aerial by design.
Marco Silva has had time and the shape shows it: organised, mid-block, no strong bias either way.
Well coached for a promoted side — McKenna got far more out of the group than its rating suggests. Overmatched, not disorganised.
An excellent low block that broke at pace. Results ran well ahead of the squad on paper, which is what cohesion is for.
Committed to playing out from the back while being comprehensively outmatched, which produced the disorganisation rather than excusing it.
Unsettled through managerial change, with a squad better than its shape. Bowen and Kudus make it right-heavy.
Fast wing-backs and little control in between; the attack lives in the wide areas.
